native.scope: Desktop foundation, native model tools, approved execution, local code editing/drafts, Git review/stage/commit, interactive PTY terminals, MCP tools/resources/prompts/OAuth, local skills and core local plugin packages. Conversation checks cover selected-text quoting without sending, retained drafts/attachments, linked edit branches, validated retry, concurrent-history rejection, dark minimum-window dialogs and actual restart. Plugin checks use real sandboxed runtimes and isolated panels, model approvals, scoped file writes, stop/reload, grant revocation, renderer crash, startup deadline, complete backup restore and actual app restart. OAuth consent uses isolated Chrome; its external-launch boundary and native file/backup dialogs are intercepted only in the test process. Native picker/default-browser interaction, broader capabilities and release remain pending.
native.composerDraftScope: Per-owner text, attachments and selections; live backup restoration and fresh extension IDs; real filesystem rejection; close failure/timeout/cancellation/late receipt and actual restart; provider validation; sending during navigation and owner deletion. Native picker/confirmation dialogs and a close callback/filesystem replacement delay use isolated test fixtures.

codeWrapping.boundary: Clipboard write is intercepted by the existing native fixture; this does not prove the physical OS clipboard.

attachments.scope: Real importer workers, source metadata, native request bytes, previews, drop/paste, rejected unsupported model, restart and complete backup including reconstruction of a missing PDF original. Native file/backup dialog boundaries are intercepted in the isolated test process; no live cloud credentials are used.

knowledge.scope: Real desktop import workers, local and synthetic-vector hybrid retrieval, eight native embedding configurations, progress/cancellation, preserved failed rebuild, selected chat evidence, unsupported citation detection, archived retry, draft restart and complete backup restoration. Dialog boundaries use isolated fixtures; no live cloud embedding quality is claimed.

checkbox.boundary: Real automation form and saved selections; disabled and mixed states are temporary DOM probes. Forced colors are emulated, not physical OS accessibility evidence.

automations.scope: Actual task UI, real timed execution/provider HTTP/cancellation, engine permissions/context/usage, pause/resume/calendar, read-only system-resume schedule checks without whole-workspace copies, failure/retry, close/restart and complete native backup. Backup dialog boundaries use isolated fixtures; real cloud accounts, operating-system toast delivery, abrupt process termination and maximum-scale performance remain separate gates.

desktop.scope: Actual desktop UI, real Electron tray creation/menu/hotkey registration/window visibility, hidden-window timed provider HTTP, draft persistence, explicit app quit/restart and complete backup restore. Shortcut/tray callback delivery, occupied-key and filesystem-failure boundaries use isolated test fixtures; physical tray pointer input, OS keyboard delivery, startup conflicts and other platforms remain separate gates.

assistants.scope: Real assistant UI, JSON/gzip files, exact Unicode/inert preview, atomic new IDs, same-name retention, native HTTP instruction delivery, deleted-profile references, app restart and complete backup. Native picker/confirmation and a filesystem EIO boundary use isolated fixtures; physical picker and other-platform interaction remain separate gates.

prompts.scope: Actual library/composer UI, keyboard tabs, literal variable preview, exact bounded append and retained context/attachments, disk-failure edit retry, native HTTP delivery, deletion, app restart and complete gzip backup. Picker/confirmation dialogs and EIO use isolated test boundaries; maximum template scale, broader accessibility and other platforms remain separate gates.

replies.scope: Actual regeneration, inert preview/cancel, selected-version HTTP continuation, atomic archive/replacement failure, independent drafts, native provider failure/stop, exact model/usage preservation, actual restart and complete gzip recovery. File-picker/confirmation and EIO boundaries use isolated fixtures; maximum scale, physical picker, broader accessibility and other platforms remain separate gates.

messageEdits.scope: Actual user/assistant plain-save without sending; preserved complete history, attachments, following messages, producing models/usage and manual provenance; selected original/edited HTTP continuation; independent editor drafts, actual close/restart before debounce, stale conflicts and explicit discard; native storage failure rejects close/backup and recovers; exact gzip recovery and owner deletion. Native file/confirmation and filesystem-failure boundaries are isolated fixtures; abrupt termination, maximum scale, broader accessibility and other platforms remain separate gates.

commands.scope: Actual unified command/chat search and native keyboard/active-descendant navigation; existing pages, thread actions, theme and isolated plugin command/panel paths; exact composer/attachment/context retention, running-reply guards, structured JSON and scoped project selection, malformed/handler failure and grant revocation, actual filesystem rollback and retry, narrow/help/error layouts, close before draft debounce, restart and complete gzip recovery without implicit command execution. Input-method event, grant mutation and native picker/confirmation/storage boundaries use isolated fixtures; physical input methods, wider accessibility/scale and other-platform audits remain separate.

backups.scope: Real native plain/gzip files above the old 64 MB limit; complete Unicode messages, knowledge records, legacy format, credential exclusion, cancelled consent, actual filesystem failure, CRC rejection, restart and light/dark/minimum-window settings. Native dialogs are intercepted only in the isolated test process.

projectTree.screenshotMethod: Electron BrowserWindow.capturePage with exact content-size assertions for all zoom and project-command captures
projectTree.scope: Real project-directory IPC, revision-bound pagination, scoped Unicode directories/junction exclusion, pointer and native ARIA tree keyboard input, selected-folder file creation/save, persisted editor drafts, keyboard file-tree visibility/cache/focus retention, actual application close/restart and dark minimum-window code/PTY input at 100/125/150 percent zoom. The sidebar stays visible; the file tree is manually hidden at 125/150 percent. Short-height layouts retain the add-project action. The populated long-name/path project dialog at 150 percent preserves complete field values and restores focus after Escape. Overflowing project switches retain the selected row and separate add action across zoom; horizontal wheel browsing stays put, focused project buttons survive resize and Tab/Enter/Escape restore settings focus without changing the selected project or editor draft. PTY output is inspected while an actual Read-Host command awaits Enter, then returned to the project PowerShell prompt. Command-palette actions preserve the same live PTY and dirty editor contents, synchronize toolbar labels, retain choices across page navigation and disable unavailable contexts. An isolated held main-process IPC load proves that actual project removal invalidates an in-flight command. Owned read failures and a delayed directory response use isolated main-process fixtures. Physical folder picker, populated maximum-scale performance, full accessibility, full backup restore and other platforms remain separate checks.

chatNavigation.screenshotMethod: Complete native Electron BrowserWindow.capturePage with exact content-size assertions
chatNavigation.scope: Current-chat message-only literal find; native keyboard, pointer and captured-pointer rail navigation; reference 26-by-2-pixel markers and one-rem edge fades; exact original UTF-16 offsets, inline Markdown spans, Unicode/metacharacters and actual code overflow; command context/focus, no-send history/draft/attachment retention; real held HTTP streaming and manual reading position; actual normal close/restart and dark 760x540 layout at 100/125/150 percent zoom. Maximum-scale, full accessibility, cross-platform and richer graphical branch navigation remain separate work.

Native picker/confirmation responses are isolated fixtures; live external providers and physical system dialogs remain separate.

mcpBinaryFiles.scope: Actual stdio resource/prompt binaries, actual bounded worker PNG normalization/corrupt failure/retry, original-byte Unicode exports, cancellation/zero-byte/SVG export-only handling, explicit text insertion, real delayed resource/worker completion selection protection, nested preview keyboard/Escape at three dark zoom levels and normal restart. Native save-picker responses are isolated fixtures; physical picker interaction and live external servers remain separate.

native.richContentScope: Native streamed inline/display/fenced math with local reference fonts and accessible MathML; reference light/dark syntax colors including PowerShell; exact copy through a clipboard fixture; isolated readonly flowchart, sequence and class diagrams; SVG geometry/path preservation, theme/minimum-window layout and manual-scroll retention; inert hostile directives/HTML/remote math commands and complete malformed/oversized source recovery. Content substitutions are persisted through the bridge and reloaded.

branchNavigation.scope: Manual sibling ordering with complete subtree/page-boundary selection, stale-client rejection, actual save failure/retry, preserved history/drafts/attachments, gzip restore/restart and dark minimum-window order controls/keyboard. Complete graph navigation, literal preview/search, archived and missing-parent paths, independent contexts/drafts/attachments, actual filesystem failure/retry and selected-path deletion, gzip recovery/normal restart, exact ambiguous-history failure/recovery and dark minimum-window keyboard/zoom. Original-parent navigation remains available; all eight parent-present and seven parent-absent header controls stay within the window at each zoom. Picker responses are isolated fixtures; no physical system-picker acceptance is claimed.

temporaryConversations.scope: Actual temporary creation, isolated draft/attachment switching, local HTTP sends/retry/stop, native branches/editing drafts, original JSON/gzip backup export, explicit Markdown export, immutable existing storage modes, minimum-window zoom and normal restart. Native file dialog responses are isolated fixtures; model providers and explicit exports/tool/plugin actions retain their own results.

mcpPdf.scope: Real stdio PDF resources and binary-only prompt, actual import/PDF renderer workers, corrupt-file recovery, delayed worker/subscription invalidation, local ownership, exact export, light/dark minimum-window zoom and keyboard/Escape, real filesystem draft-save rejection and idempotent retry, restart, complete backup/live missing-original restore and one explicit local model request. Native picker responses and a held restore acknowledgement at the main IPC boundary are isolated fixtures; external servers and physical picker interaction remain separate.

assistantRecipes.scope: Actual library/composer recipe forms, keyboard choice editing, literal default/optional/prototype expansion, explicit assistant selection and untouched context, actual stale-assistant rejection/retry, three native zoom/focus/Escape checks, real gzip backup and normal restart. Picker/confirmation responses are isolated fixtures; physical picker and wider platform/accessibility checks remain separate.

promptTransfer.scope: Actual native library exports and plain/gzip/content-detected input, full inert parameter/profile preview, cancellation, actual atomic-write rejection/retry, fresh shared associations, native minimum-window zoom/focus/Escape, complete gzip backup and normal restart with zero model requests. System-picker and confirmation results are intercepted only in this isolated process; physical picker and wider platform checks remain separate.

memories.scope: Explicit CRUD, scope promotion, disabled state, persistence, search, escaped text, theme/narrow layout and project removal. Engine scope and temporary-chat isolation have separate component tests.

browser.scope: Actual private WebContentsView and real local HTTP website, history, redirect, popup/private-scheme rejection, stop/real connection failure/retry, Ctrl L focus, page retention, modal occlusion, six fixed-device-scale theme/zoom cases and normal application restart. Shell and native child content captures remain separate originals. External public services, physical input, permission grants, downloads, saved tabs/history, browser automation, other monitors/platforms and full design acceptance remain separate.

Local branch creation/switching only; remote/worktree creation UI, physical input, accessibility, full reference design and distribution remain pending.

projectWorktrees.scope: Real Git repositories/worktrees/hooks and native main/Quick bridges, Monaco, atomic project-save EIO and restart; fixed display scale and scripted input. Worktree deletion/pruning, managed roots, task orchestration, broader accessibility and complete reference parity remain separate gates.

Workspace backups retain preferences and do not contain Git worktree files. Automatic deletion, upstream fetching, snapshots, complete reference parity and physical system picker interaction remain separate.

worktreeOverview.scope: Real isolated Git fixtures and main-process worktree IPC; persisted fixture workspace is seeded only in the suite-owned profile and restored on success. Git error/held-read responses are intercepted only in the test process. Known-project inventory and persistent conversation labels are read-only. Opening/creating/deleting conversations, automatic cleanup, upstream refresh and full reference parity are separate.

worktreeConversations.scope: Actual registered-project conversation navigation and draft persistence; suite-owned workspace and Git fixtures, real atomic rename EIO and isolated held/load error boundaries. New project chat selects an existing draft and creates no persistent conversation until normal explicit sending. Git deletion, unregistered-path registration, upstream fetching and complete reference parity remain separate.

worktreeUpstream.scope: Real settings persistence/EIO, local bare-repository fetches, pinned local creation, missing/unavailable remotes, never policy, gzip restore and normal restart. Creation hold is an isolated IPC boundary before the actual fetch; actual fetch queue locking has separate unit coverage. Native Tab/Shift+Tab reach the switch and Space invokes actual failed saves in all six theme/zoom cases, with complete focus outlines. No live external network, credential dialog, destructive cleanup or full reference acceptance is claimed.

worktreeRegistration.scope: Actual external worktree project registration, real primary-workspace rename EIO, same-ID retries, duplicate preservation, delayed IPC source revalidation, gzip restoration and normal restart. No Git writes from registration, model requests, app-created ownership, destructive cleanup, physical picker, full reference parity or distribution acceptance is claimed.

worktreeOwnership.scope: Actual desktop creation receipt and retained-file warning integration only. Local pin service has separate unit coverage; pin UI, destructive cleanup, snapshots/restoration, full reference parity and current distribution require separate acceptance.

worktreePinning.scope: Actual local worktree pin UI, strict full-window bridge, write/source/read failures, same-profile gzip restore separation, local restart and replaced-directory rejection. Quick Chat restrictions, cross-profile creation-authority transfer, snapshots, destructive cleanup, full reference parity and current distribution require separate evidence.
